description: This file defines an abstract class 'PressVibrator' that manages vibration behavior for device-specific implementations in an Android application. It includes methods for setting vibration durations, triggering vibrations, and controlling suppression of vibrations.

classes.name: PressVibrator
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for device-specific vibration control, including methods to set durations, trigger vibrations, and manage suppression.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Abstract method to set the duration of a vibration.

methods.name: setLongPressDuration
methods.description: Abstract method to set the duration for long press vibrations.

methods.name: setUseSystemVibration
methods.description: Method intended to configure system-wide vibration settings; default implementation is empty.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Abstract method to trigger vibration, with a parameter indicating if it is a long press.

methods.name: suppressNextVibration
methods.description: Static method to suppress the next vibration.

methods.name: checkSuppressed
methods.description: Static method to check if vibration is suppressed and reset the suppression flag.

methods.name: getVibrator
methods.description: Returns the Vibrator instance associated with this class.
